d:
On the festive occasion of Eid we present a true gem from Salim - Sulaiman, Bismillah. Featuring the fantastic talent, of Kailash Kher, and Munawar Masoom Khan - the song is a back-to-roots style, sufi - influenced composition. You don't wanna miss this one!

Credits:
Composed & Produced by Salim -- Sulaiman
Singers: Kailash Kher & Munawar Masoom
Lyrics: Irfan Siddiqui
Drums: Darshan Doshi
Guitar: Warren Mendonsa
